criteria.excluded_scenarios: Every dedicated randomized/legacy-randomized case excluded from both summaries. Play-equivalent has randomized 0..3 physical-step actuator delays, so it is supplemental only.
criteria.failure_priority: policy failure/incomplete-ended cycles precede actuator comparison; process/resource aborts are not policy failures
criteria.hardware_limit_basis: recorded simulation effort limits: first6 120Nm, feet27Nm, wheels40Nm; actual motor current/continuous/thermal limits are unknown
criteria.landing_definition: Existing longest all-four clear segment; its first subsequent any-body10N contact is landing onset. Physical sample time frame*.02+(substep+1)*.005 must be strictly smaller. This is a force-threshold operational definition, not exact continuous contact time.
criteria.margin_layer_method: within the same motion hash, rank Pareto layers on worst normalized computed torque, foot computed-over-limit fraction, and worst applied shank torque; all minimize; retain ties with countermetrics
criteria.old_randomized_alias: randomized-no-push remains separately identified; its randomization is not assumed equal to current-randomized-no-push
criteria.peak_semantics: force is average net normal force over5ms, excluding friction; PD drive torque excludes passive/internal impact loads
criteria.priority_confirmed_by_user: failure risk and actuator headroom, then posture, landing load and tracking
criteria.recorded_headroom_order_limit: All foot over-limit fractions become zero, and max computed effort ratio equals shank torque/120 for every candidate. Thus the existing primary rule reduces to worst shank peak; foot absolute peak is a reported countermetric, not an added ranking weight.
criteria.relative_metric_limitations: This normalized RMS gap is not a percent of failed samples and not a percentage relative to one side; low-amplitude pairs can have high relative gaps, absolute values are retained.
criteria.scope: Fixed-condition recorded-test priority; excludes randomization robustness inference.
criteria.scope_sensitivity: 1N landing onset peaks and before-own-wheel-first10N-contact peaks retained separately; main uses common first post-flight contact to exclude any already-started landing.
criteria.sign_handling: main ranking uses magnitude gap; signed gaps provided with descriptive reference-fit sign; zero reference does not establish physical mirror sign
criteria.symmetry_hardware_acceptance: no numeric threshold approved; tiers are descriptive engineering advice, not hardware pass/fail
criteria.symmetry_order: Recompute failure/torque-margin layers after scenario exclusion, then the same five symmetry metrics within each NEW layer.
criteria.symmetry_scope: all ten joints, five left-right pairs; no joint type omitted
criteria.symmetry_vector_sensitivity: 13 individual metrics: 5 torque gap terms, 5 velocity gap terms, wheel touchdown gap, left wheel peak, right wheel peak
criteria.timing_symmetry_metric: worst full-cycle wheel contact time gap using existing 10N definition; 1N sensitivity retained
criteria.torque_symmetry_metric: worst case and command phase RMS(abs(applied_left)-abs(applied_right))/recorded pair effort limit, maximum over all five pairs
criteria.velocity_symmetry_metric: worst-case RMS(abs(left velocity)-abs(right velocity))/pooled pair RMS velocity; all five pairs; wheel uses only after both wheels first touchdown at10N, all other pairs use full successful cycle
criteria.wheel_speed_peak_metric: Separate max abs left and right wheel velocity from cycle start strictly before first post-flight contact (any of four contact bodies at10N); exclude entire first contact5ms sample and all later samples.
criteria.wheel_speed_peak_scope: Pre-landing only; preparation/push-off/airborne samples before post-flight landing included. Contact-step and post-landing maxima are historical evidence only, not ranking metrics.
criteria.wheel_velocity_difference_exclusion: Unchanged: wheel velocity differences only after both wheels first touchdown; pre-landing differences excluded. Peak and difference use intentionally distinct user-requested windows.
